scope: Canonical Puerto Williams entity, Isla Navarino local graph, current Chilean-source verification records and regression QA

checks.name: canonical_entity_identity
checks.notes: Puerto Williams uses canonical ID puerto_williams and remains distinct from Puerto Toro and Puerto Navarino. Administrative hierarchy is explicit.

checks.name: museum_name_normalization
checks.notes: Museo Territorial Yagan Usi - Martín González Calderón is the canonical current node; Museo Antropológico Martin Gusinde and Museo Martín Gusinde are aliases only.

checks.name: living_yagan_context
checks.notes: Villa Ukika is modeled as contemporary Yagan community context and not as a static tourism attraction.

checks.name: graph_referential_integrity
checks.notes: All graph edge targets used in the normalized v1.1 graph are represented by canonical or local graph nodes, including cabo_de_hornos.

checks.name: stable_dynamic_separation
checks.notes: Routes, terminals, hospital, fuel, telecom and banking infrastructure are separated from current schedules, stock, uptime, specialist availability and operational state.

checks.name: antarctic_gateway_scope
checks.notes: Gateway policy/strategy context is not converted into proof of direct current commercial Antarctic flights or fly-cruise service from Puerto Williams.

checks.name: transport_inference_controls
checks.notes: Puerto Navarino ramp does not imply regular international passenger ferry; Puerto Williams-Puerto Toro subsidized transport is not modeled as a standard tourism product.

checks.name: trail_and_safety_scope
checks.notes: Dientes de Navarino and related trail contexts preserve dynamic safety and access requirements; old tourism-map claims do not override current public-safety evidence.

checks.name: qa_manual_review
checks.notes: All 15 regression cases are supported by the current structured corpus and canonical rules. This is a manual/static review; an executable retrieval runner is still pending.

checks.name: authoritative_geospatial_geometry
checks.notes: Puerto Williams and local nodes still require authoritative IDE Chile/IGM/MOP/other competent-source geometries with producer, dataset/layer, CRS, geometry type and retrieval date. Tourism-map positions are not promotable.

checks.name: heritage_detail_validation
checks.notes: Casa Stirling, Antigua Comandancia Naval and Primera Casa de Puerto Williams have stable map-level heritage context but still need stronger current Chilean heritage-source detail before richer canonical descriptions.

checks.name: executable_rag_qa_runner
checks.notes: QA is regression data ready for a future runner but has not yet been executed against vector retrieval or an agent runtime.

checks.name: chunk_level_embedding_readiness
checks.notes: The canonical entity separates stable and dynamic fields, but embedding readiness has not yet been applied chunk by chunk. Dynamic service state must remain outside general semantic embeddings.

checks.name: commercial_directory_completeness
checks.notes: No complete institutional 2026 directory of current shops, pharmacies or other commercial services is established; this is intentionally excluded from canonical stable knowledge.

checks.name: live_service_freshness
checks.notes: Schedules, road/trail conditions, fuel stock, telecom outages, cash availability, water interruptions and specialist/emergency availability require live or recent verification at answer time.

checks.name: canonical_source_record_coverage
checks.notes: Final PR review confirmed that the canonical Puerto Williams entity now references the verification records supporting trails, connectivity, health, emergency response, energy/telecom/banking, urban services, Antarctic-air claim controls, local graph and extracted SERNATUR source records.

prohibited_release_claims: All Puerto Williams service information is current in real time.
Puerto Williams has verified direct regular commercial flights to Antarctica.
Puerto Navarino has a verified regular international passenger ferry solely because a ramp exists.
Puerto Williams-Puerto Toro is a normal tourism ferry product.
Tourism-map positions are authoritative canonical coordinates.
recommended_next_actions: Merge Batch 03 only after PR checks remain green on the final head commit.
Follow with authoritative geospatial feature discovery for Puerto Williams/Isla Navarino nodes.
Implement executable RAG QA runner and chunk-level embedding-readiness tagging in a separate technical PR.
